chain.name: workshop
chain.description: Create the three-section chapter frame: Workshop, Story, and Discussion, grounded in the epic and chapter plan.

chain.name: research
chain.description: Deepen and verify the chapter material, attaching era, place, figures, events, sources, and grounding notes.

chain.name: seeds
chain.description: Curate the chapter seed by selecting included characters, quality parameters, mood-shaped summary, and segment structure.

chain.name: correctness
chain.description: Check factual claims, names, dates, terms, and source traceability; record corrections and uncertainties.

chain.name: theme
chain.description: Assign the chapter theme, theme essence, contemporary mapping, and form-consistent stereotype selection.

chain.name: syntax
chain.description: Apply the selected syntax guidance so the chapter remains elevated, modern, readable, and ready for writing.

chain.name: override
chain.description: Human-in-the-loop gate: review, adjust, or override any prior filter output before writing begins.

chain.name: quality
chain.description: Final quality gate: verify completeness, consistency, register, and readiness for promotion.
